name: Apple MacBook Air 13-inch (M3, 2024)
excerpt: Two Thunderbolt / USB 4 ports with support for Charging, DisplayPort, Thunderbolt 3 (up to 40Gb/s), USB 4 (up to 40Gb/s). Simultaneously supports full native resolution on built-in display and one external display up to 6K at 60Hz; supports two external displays with laptop lid closed (one up to 5K at 60Hz and second up to 4K at 60Hz). Fast-charge capable with 70W USB-C Power Adapter.
